scope: Restore the dwdcc.kr development platform after a host reboot; preserve database, identity and app data. This record precedes the separate 0.12.1 version rollout.

incident.cause: Existing PostgreSQL and Keycloak containers had Docker restart policy no. They stayed stopped after reboot, while enabled Core/worker units retried. Portal APIs and IdP discovery returned 502.
incident.userSymptom: Server connection failed; existing login state was retained.

actions: Stopped the retrying Core and worker units.
Changed only the existing PostgreSQL and Keycloak containers restart policies to unless-stopped.
Started PostgreSQL and waited for TCP readiness; started Keycloak and waited for configured issuer discovery.
Started Core and worker and checked all three public health endpoints.
preserved: Container identities, images, mounts, networks and memory limits
Database records and schema 23; no migration or reseed
Server and CLI 0.10.0; portal and frame asset bytes
Five running healthy apps and three intentionally stopped apps

verification.command: Normalized docker inspect comparison plus systemctl is-enabled and public HTTPS health
verification.observed: Both dependencies running with unless-stopped; Docker/Core/worker enabled; three health responses 200; existing app states preserved.
Ordinary OIDC, purpose-separated sessions, CLI device approval and generated stdio MCP.

failuresRetained.reason: First preservation assertion compared mount list order. Recovery had completed; normalization by mount destination confirmed the same mounts and other checked metadata. Original failure record retained.

notRun.scope: A second host/VM reboot and external Windows/macOS acceptance
notRun.reason: No reboot was performed for testing; restart policy and running services were inspected. User will perform separate VM validation.

recurrencePrevention.desiredConfiguration: compose.yaml already declares unless-stopped for PostgreSQL and Keycloak. Check actual installed container policies, not only the Compose source.
recurrencePrevention.historicalOverride: .local/address-move-20261117-dev2/compose-keycloak-override.json records the old restart:no state. Keep it as historical evidence, do not reuse it as a current recreation override.
recurrencePrevention.rolloutPreflight: The subsequent maintained rollout tool change requires both dependencies running with unless-stopped before a core upgrade.
